title: The Ant Lion
text: The sand gives way without a sound and slides, and slides, into a funnel as wide as a field. Bones ring the slope, picked clean and polished. At the bottom, a pair of mandibles opens and waits.

outcomes.text: Out, gasping, sand in everything, the mandibles clicking far below.
It collapses the sand beneath you as you scramble up the slope, and you plunge down toward its open maw.

options.label: The strongest tries to haul everyone out as they scramble for the rim.

outcomes.text: One by one, arms shaking, and the mandibles snap shut on nothing.

options.label: It's too treacherous to attempt escape. Draw your weapons and dispatch the beast.

outcomes.text: It fights from the bottom of its pit, and when it finally dies, one of its mandibles comes away whole: long, hooked and still wet with venom.
